Blood Frenzy.desc: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain an additional $/10;16959s1 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a $m2% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Feral Instinct.desc: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by $s2% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were ${$m1/5} $llevel:levels; higher.

Feral Swiftness.desc: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by $m2%, and increases your chance to Dodge by $m1%.

Ferocity.desc: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by $/10;s1 Rage or Energy.

Furor.desc: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain $/10;17057s1 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores ${100*($m2/100)}% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus ${10*($m2/100)} Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to ${100*($m2/100)} Energy.

Genesis.desc: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by $s1%.

Heart of the Wild.desc: Increases your Intellect by $s1%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by $s2% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by $s3%.

Lacerate.desc: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for $o1 damage over $d plus $s2% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to $u times on the same target.

Leader of the Pack.desc: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within $24932a1 yards by $24932s1%.

Natural Instinct.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by $m1% and increases your spell healing by $s2% of your Intellect.

Naturalist.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by $/1000;S1 sec and increases all damage you deal by $m2%.

Nature's Majesty.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by $s1%.

Nature's Reach.desc: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by $m1% and improves your chance to hit by $m2%.

Predatory Discipline.desc: Your Ferocious Bite ability no longer converts extra Energy into damage, but still deals extra damage based on your excess Energy.

Predatory Strikes.desc: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by $s1% of your level.

Primal Bite.desc: Bite the target, dealing $s2% normal damage plus $s1 and generating a high amount of threat.

Rend and Tear.desc: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by $m1%.

Savage Fury.desc: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by $s1%.

Sharpened Claws.desc: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by $s1%.

Shifting Power.desc: Instantly convert $c Mana into $s2 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

Shredding Attacks.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by $m1 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by ${$m2/-10}.

Thick Hide.desc: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain $s2 additional base Armor per level and another ${$m1/100}.2 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
